purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.16.0 (adds Paper 1 version 2).
result: 2954 of 2954 modules compiled; 2953 of 2954 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs)
procedure: New empty output directory; sources copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean and Research/, 2956 files). After the build their SHA-256 hashes were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.

Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py (build5.py of version 1.15.0, except that in the leanchecker phase a module no longer waits for the leanchecker runs of its imports, which leanchecker does not need). This is not a lake build.
Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does.

runs.note: Up to 16 jobs. Compile phase until 12:40:40Z, leanchecker phase from 12:40:41Z. The computer ran out of commit memory: 4 modules failed to compile (3 could not read a compiled Mathlib file, 1 stopped with Windows exit code 0xC0000005), so 102 modules that import them were skipped, and 14 leanchecker runs failed to read a compiled file. Status at the end: status-pass1.json.

The same driver with up to 8 jobs and the option --retry-failed, which reruns only modules marked failed or skipped. All 106 modules compiled; 16 leanchecker runs, of modules that import many large Paper 7 modules, still failed to read a compiled file. Status at the end: status-pass2.json.
The leanchecker phase only, for those 16 modules, 2 jobs at a time: all passed. Final status: status.json.

failed_attempts: Logs with the suffix .attemptN (174 logs, in 39 modules, all of Paper 7): 167 failed to read a compiled file, 3 std::bad_alloc, 2 out of memory, 1 empty log, and 1 compile stopped with exit code 0xC0000005 (Research.Backfill.Paper7.MomentGapD_00_04_05, which compiled in the second run). No attempt ended in a Lean error. The same modules passed at the first attempt in the rebuild of version 1.15.0.

module_Research.how_counted: readModuleData on Research.olean (research-olean-constants.txt in the log archive)
module_Research.consequence: leanchecker has nothing to replay in this module. It was exempted before the run, as for version 1.15.0.

warnings: 97 lines in 15 older modules; none in Paper 1. Fewer than for version 1.15.0 (260 lines in 28 modules) because 13 modules Research/ICG*.lean were replaced by versions that use the current names of three Mathlib lemmas (if_pos, if_neg, if_true replaced by ite_eq_left, ite_eq_right, ite_true); nothing else in them changed.
axioms: every printed axiom list is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The 56 lists printed by Research.Backfill.Paper1.FinalContractAudit (the 51 statements, one calibration and four internal lemmas) are each exactly these three axioms.
forbidden_tokens: logs/clean-replay-v1.16.0-forbidden-tokens.log: outside comments, only the intentional sorry statements of the comparator challenge files lean/Comparator/.
logs_note: In the published logs the two local directories are replaced by <workspace> and <worker>; nothing else is changed.
